text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan seized the summit. Oguri Cap 
praises her running, comparing its 
brilliance to colorful, intricate 
glassware.

And alongside Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno 
Muteki, Mejiro Ardan was recognized by the 
crowd as one of the "Big Three," and 
together they shared in that joy.

"Now," with a radiant brilliance, the 
eternal light of Mejiro Ardan's trail has 
been carved into history.

Having poured out every ounce of her 
strength, Mejiro Ardan listened to the 
venue's resounding cheers of blessing as 
she leaned on her Trainer for support—
